blocks.raw: <Tip>A Master's degree in Architecture reduces the DAE requirement by **one (1) year** (from 2 years to 1 year). This is a commonly tested advantage. The reduction applies only to Master's degrees from CHED-recognized institutions. A Master's in a non-architecture field does not qualify.</Tip>
